This is a PDF guide; ensure high-quality text extraction. Run OCR fallback only if scanned elements appear (unlikely for a born-digital guide).
Crawl the full agentskills.io site — /specification is the main spec but /integrate-skills and related pages contain integration patterns worth indexing.
Index the README only. Do NOT follow the 1000+ linked skill repositories — would blow corpus size. The curation itself is the valuable artifact.
